newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and representatives of international financial institutions and the Europan Union will hold a joint press conference this evening at 2030 local.
Ciorbea will present an evaluation on the social and economic situation in Romania.
* Representatives of trade unions said the government must launch concrete social security measures, the radio said, quoting sources from senior trade unionists.
* U.S Congressman Tom Lantos met Ion Iliescu, President of the opposition Party of Social Democracy. They had talks on bilateral ties and enlargement of NATO.
* The chairman of Russia's lower house of parliament, Gennady Seleznyov arrived in Romania to meet senior officials and discuss bilateral relations.
